description: This file declares the RialtoSessionServerStub class, which is a stub implementation for testing the Rialto session server. It includes method declarations for starting the stub, retrieving client socket, sending events, and disconnecting clients. It also defines an enum for stub responses and includes necessary headers and member variables.

classes.name: RialtoSessionServerStub
classes.description: A stub class for simulating a Rialto session server in tests, providing methods to control and interact with the stub.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the stub with a specified response type.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Simulates sending a state changed event.

methods.name: sendAckEvent
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment event with a ping ID and success status.
